mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, avatar_asset_id FROM user_account WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, friend_id, status, created_at FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId} LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id AS request_id, f.status, f.user_id AS requester_id, u.username AS requester_username, u.nickname AS requester_nickname, u.avatar_asset_id AS requester_avatar_asset_id, f.created_at FROM friend f INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = f.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE f.friend_id = #{receiverId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT f.id AS request_id, f.status, f.user_id AS requester_id, u.username AS requester_username, u.nickname AS requester_nickname, u.avatar_asset_id AS requester_avatar_asset_id, f.created_at FROM friend f INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = f.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE f.id = #{requestId} AND f.friend_id = #{receiverId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id AS request_id, f.status, f.user_id AS requester_id, u.username AS requester_username, u.nickname AS requester_nickname, u.avatar_asset_id AS requester_avatar_asset_id, f.created_at FROM friend f INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = f.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE f.id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (user_id, friend_id, status) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{receiverId}, 'PENDING')
INSERT INTO friend (user_id, friend_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, 'FRIEND') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'FRIEND'
